changelog: v0.2.0: Add scripts/follow.py - tail -F equivalent for live log monitoring, log-aware. Streams new lines as they arrive with the same --pattern / --not-pattern / --level / --since filters as grep.py. Automatic log-rotation detection (inode change or file truncation triggers transparent reopen). --max-events N exits cleanly after N matched events (CI-friendly), --timeout SECONDS exits on inactivity, --json emits per-line JSON envelopes with extracted timestamp + level. Closes the only documented limitation from v0.1.x ('It does not tail/follow live log files').
